headline.purpose: Day word and time on the clock face; 40px from 960px.

label.purpose: Row labels, day headers, lamp text, meta.

figure.purpose: Headline numbers such as split views; same face for table and metric values.

unit.purpose: HRS / MIN units under the segment readout.

shadows.name: housing-edge
shadows.purpose: Clock housing edge and top catch light; sheets use the catch light alone.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (.15s press, .2s color, .25s rewind, .32s sheet rise).

motion.name: hold
motion.purpose: Hold-to-approve fill, gold progress bar and bezel conic sweep; early release rewinds in .25s.

motion.name: ring

motion.purpose: Hold progress is information, so it survives reduced motion.

components.name: Round Clock
components.description: Housing plus inset face with phase lamp, seven-segment countdown, units and day word; the signature container.

components.css: .ds-clock { --led: var(--red-ink, #F0605A); max-width:390px; border-radius: var(--r-housing, 18px); padding:6px; background: var(--housing, #121214); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule, #26252A), inset 0 1px 0 var(--rule-hi, #3A3840); } .ds-face { display:grid; gap:6px; padding:14px 16px; border-radius:12px; background: var(--face, #08080A); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #000, inset 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6); color: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-phase { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; } .ds-lamp { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color: var(--dust, #9C958B); } .ds-lamp i { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:#2b2a2e; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6); } .ds-lamp.ds-red { color: var(--red-ink, #F0605A); } .ds-lamp.ds-red i { background:#E43A33; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35); } .ds-lamp.ds-gold { color: var(--gold, #C49040); } .ds-lamp.ds-gold i { background:#D9A552; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35); } .ds-seg { display:block; width:100%; max-width:236px; height:auto; overflow:visible; } .ds-seg .on { fill: var(--led); } .ds-seg .off { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--led) 7%, transparent); } .ds-colon { animation: ds-blink 2s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity:.15; } } .ds-units { display:flex; gap:16px; margin:6px 0 0; font: 500 11px/1 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; color: var(--dust, #9C958B); } .ds-when { margin:6px 0 0; font: 30px/1 'Bebas Neue', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; } .ds-meta { margin:0; font-size:13px; color: var(--dust, #9C958B); }

components.name: Phase Lamps

components.html: All clearYes waitingWinner this week

components.css: .ds-program { display:grid; gap:6px; max-width:360px; padding:14px 16px; border-radius:12px; background: var(--face, #08080A); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row1 { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin:0; font-size:13px; color: var(--dust, #9C958B); } .ds-row1 b { font: 600 13px 'Geist Mono', monospace; color: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); } .ds-rounds { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap:6px; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; } .ds-rounds li { display:grid; gap:3px; } .ds-c { height:10px; border-radius:3px; background:#1D1C20; } .ds-posted { background: var(--dust, #9C958B); } .ds-scheduled { background:transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--dust, #9C958B); } .ds-needs { background: rgba(200,32,32,.12); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--red, #C82020); } .ds-failed { background: var(--red, #C82020); } .ds-win { background: var(--gold, #C49040); } .ds-next { background: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); } .ds-d { font: 500 11px/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; color: var(--dust, #9C958B); text-align:center; } .ds-d.ds-today { color: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); }

components.name: Hold To Approve
components.description: Press and hold 1.2s: a darker red sweeps across, a gold bar runs along the bottom; the done state turns gold.
components.css: .ds-hold { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; max-width:320px; min-height:52px; padding:0 24px; border:0; border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 10px); background: var(--red, #C82020); color:#fff; font: 600 16px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; overflow:hidden; isolation:isolate; cursor:pointer; user-select:none; } .ds-hold:hover { background:#D42626; } .ds-hold:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #C49040); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-hold .ds-fill { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:-1; background:#6E0E0E; transform-origin:left; transform:scaleX(0); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-hold .ds-prog { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:4px; background: var(--gold, #C49040); transform-origin:left; transform:scaleX(0); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-hold:active .ds-fill, .ds-hold:active .ds-prog { transform:scaleX(1); transition: transform 1.2s linear; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lit paper fill with black text; the default action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 24px; border:0; border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 10px); background: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); color: var(--canvas, #0B0B0D); font: 600 16px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #C49040); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Line Button

components.css: .ds-btn-line { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 24px; border:0; border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 10px); background:transparent; color: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-hi, #3A3840); font: 600 16px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-line:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dust, #9C958B); } .ds-btn-line:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #C49040); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Hairline chip with a mono count; the active chip is lit paper.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; } .ds-chip { min-height:40px; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 10px); background:transparent; color: var(--dust, #9C958B); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule, #26252A); font: 500 14px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-chip span { margin-left:4px; font-family:'Geist Mono', monospace; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dust, #9C958B); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); color: var(--canvas, #0B0B0D); box-shadow:none; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #C49040); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Idea Field
components.description: Text well sunk to the face color with a bezel border and a gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; max-width:420px; color: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); font: 600 16px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field textarea { min-height:112px; padding:16px; border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 10px); background: var(--face, #08080A); border:1px solid var(--rule-hi, #3A3840); color: var(--paper, #EEE7DC); font: 400 16px/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--gold, #C49040); resize:vertical; } .ds-field textarea::placeholder { color: var(--dust, #9C958B); } .ds-field textarea:focus { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #C49040); outline-offset:1px; border-color:transparent; }

components.css: .ds-metric { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 92px; gap:12px; align-items:center; max-width:420px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-meter { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(24, 1fr); gap:2px; height:14px; } .ds-meter i { border-radius:2px; background:#1D1C20; } .ds-meter i.on { background: var(--gold, #C49040); } .ds-norm { position:absolute; top:-5px; bottom:-5px; width:2px; margin-left:-1px; border-radius:1px; background: var(--red, #C82020); } .ds-v { text-align:right; font: 600 14px 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--gold, #C49040); } .ds-v small { display:block; font-size:12px; font-weight:400; color: var(--dust, #9C958B); }

narrative.overview:
The control center is the round clock bolted to the gym wall. It is read in a glance between rounds, from across the room, with gloves half on. A matte black housing holds an inset, slightly recessed face; on the face, seven-segment numerals count down to the next post with their unlit segments ghosted, a single phase lamp says whether anything needs attention, and a strip of fourteen cells shows the week as a program of rounds. Everything else in the product is the same hardware seen up close: LED meters for results, state lights on schedule rows, a segment digit counting down an undo.

The system is dark, dense where it reports and sparse where it asks. It speaks in light, not in fills: color appears as a lit lamp, a lit segment or a lit cell, almost never as a painted panel. Red means a yes is waiting or something failed, gold means a win or a milestone, paper means all clear. The one decisive act, approving a week, is a physical gesture: you hold START and the bezel fills around the clock until it rings.

It refuses the creator-scheduler default: no KPI tile rows, no calendar grid, no card stacks. Brand stays binding from the fight-poster side: brand black, combat red, gold for wins, Bebas headlines, premium and serious, never playful or pastel.
keyCharacteristics: Housing plus inset face as the one container idea; depth is carved inward, not lifted outward.
Seven-segment SVG numerals with ghosted unlit segments for the hero figure and the undo count.
Three phase colors (red, gold, paper) carried by lamps, segments and cells.
Every number in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Press-and-hold and timed undo as the two guards on any action that changes what gets posted.

rules.name: The Three Lights Rule
rules.body: Only red, gold and paper may glow. Red is attention (a yes is waiting, something failed), gold is a win or a confirmation, paper is all clear or "this one". No other hue enters the interface.

rules.name: The Light, Not Paint Rule
rules.body: State color is carried by lamps, lit segments, cells, outlines and short ink, not by filled panels. The waiting block is the one tinted surface, and only as a faint red wash (10% to 4%) under a red hairline.

rules.name: The Ink Split Rule
rules.body: Brand red (`red`) is for fills and marks; any red text under 18px uses `red-ink`.

rules.name: The Scoreboard Rule
rules.body: Every figure (counts, times, views, x-normal, percentages) is Geist Mono with tabular numerals. Words are never set in mono except clock-face units.

rules.name: The Poster Words Rule
rules.body: Bebas only announces: titles, the day word, the verdict word. It never sets a sentence, a button or a number that has to be compared.

rules.name: The Carved-In Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces never cast drop shadows. Depth comes from inset edges and the recessed face; only layers that appear and go away may lift.

dos: **Do** draw hero numerals as seven-segment SVG with unlit segments ghosted at 7% of the lit color.
**Do** keep color to the three lights: red for a waiting yes or a failure, gold for a win or confirmation, paper for all clear.
**Do** set every figure in Geist Mono with tabular numerals, and compare views against the 2.6k normal line, not raw numbers alone.
**Do** guard any action that changes what posts with a 1.2s hold or a 4s timed undo.
**Do** keep depth carved in: housing edge plus inset face; drop shadows only on undo bar and toast.
**Do** use the radius family exactly: 18px housing, 12px face, 10px controls.
**Do** label every time as New York time.
donts: **Don't** build KPI tile rows, calendar grids or card stacks; report in rows, cells and meters.
**Don't** introduce any hue beyond black, red, gold and the neutrals; no pastel, no wellness softness.
**Don't** fill panels with state color; light a lamp, a segment or an outline instead.
**Don't** set red text under 18px in `red`; use `red-ink`.
**Don't** set sentences, buttons or comparable numbers in Bebas.
**Don't** add a light theme; the wall is black.
